[To [Elizabeth Missing Sewell](people/person_1301.qmd)]

All right. [M](people/person_939.qmd) sends them to me for nothing. You shall have them. Has he sent you the [Scripture Readings](cmy_books/cmybook_87.qmd)

C M Y

---

[^1]: A postcard postmarked Winchester D My 13 71 and Ventnor My 14.
